notes:
Background: Pelion is a mid-size legal-tech firm building a unified precedents and contracts search product. Currently using an internal PostgreSQL + pgvector prototype and Elastic for metadata faceting. Evaluating Redwood for production-grade inference and managed routing.

Primary pain: scale and cost — want to index 20M-100M documents initially with growth to 300M+; current pgvector setup struggles at 50M, high tail latency on reranking. Need <150ms p95 query to be product-viable; willing to trade raw recall for latency and cost guarantees.

Quoted requirements from Head of ML (call 2026-02-19): "We need a hybrid stack: cheap, dense-vector storage + high-quality reranking on a tuned LLM. If cheaper vector DBs can handle ANN, Redwood should route rerank calls to a smaller dedicated LLM pool."

Vector DB considerations: Pinecone demo showed strong latency but cost per q unclear; pgvector attractive for control and SQL joins but operations headache; Weaviate liked for metadata filters and MMR support. Need connectors: bulk upsert with parallel shards, CDC from Postgres, namespace/tagging, hybrid search (sparse + dense), support for metadata filters and approximate top-k with consistent scoring for reranker.

Security/compliance notes: must keep EU residency for source docs, SSO via SAML required, audit logs and retention controls mandatory. KMS integration required for encryption-at-rest and key rotation policy.

POC ask: index 50M doc subset, measure end-to-end p95 latency for typical user flow (filter + ANN + rerank), compare cost per query across Pinecone vs pgvector self-hosted + Redwood serving, validate connector reliability under CDC load.

Commercial: procurement prefers annual committed Dedicated or Private deployment. Interested in Redwood Optimize to tune batching/quantization and save token costs.

Quotes/quick fragments from calls: "If p95 stays >200ms users churn — latency = UX risk."; "We need a deterministic fallback plan when primary vector DB hits rate limits."

Next concrete items: SE to run ingestion script (sample pipeline), schedule 2-hour POC kickoff (wk of 2026-03-15), security team to receive DPA + SOC2 evidence, pricing follow-up email with Dedicated and Private skus.
